about_the_game:
Aim to Capture is a stylish horror visual novel where you take on the role of a spy diving into the memories of others to find dirt on a sinister biocorporation.

Episode One drops you into a mind of a worn-out delivery guy who stumbles upon something strange and terrifying at the end of his shift. Reflect, make choices, develop his character, and experience rich interactive elements as you unravel the mystery that's taken hold of his mind.

What features does Episode One offer?

Traits!

Your decisions unlock a wide variety of character traits, each offering unique reactions and choices that shape Bint’s journey and lead to multiple possible endings.
A full playthrough of Episode One takes around 3–4 hours.

Alchemy of Thoughts!

Sometimes, you’ll get a chance to pause and enter a Reflection phase where you can chain thoughts together to create new traits and explore Bint’s mind and memories.

Interactivity!

Stumble upon interactive bits and puzzles, packed with lore, odd details, and things that just might change how you see the story.
